layout.navigation: Sticky bottom nav with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0f0f0f]/80 and border-t border-white/10 for mobile. Top app bar for desktop.
layout.cards: Flat solid surfaces (bg-[#1a1a1a]), 1px border-white/10, rounded-xl. Hover state: border-cyan-400/50, -translate-y-1, shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.15)]
layout.bento_grid: Tight gap-4 for dashboards. Elements span columns based on priority.

components.buttons: rounded-lg font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-sm transition-all duration-200. Primary: bg-cyan-400 text-black hover:bg-cyan-500. Ghost: border border-white/10 text-white hover:border-cyan-400
components.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 bg-[#0f0f0f]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-white/10 flex justify-around items-center z-40
components.role_preview_switcher: Fixed bottom-20 right-4 z-50 bg-white text-black p-3 rounded-full shadow-lg border border-black/10 flex items-center gap-2 font-medium hover:scale-105 transition-transform

hero_backgrounds.description: Dark stadium lights, athletic texture. Use with a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0f0f0f] to-transparent).

action_shots.description: Men playing football. Use for Flag Football sport selection card.
Man kicking ball on green turf. Use for Kickball sport selection card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a mobile-first web app using Shadcn UI and Tailwind CSS. Use .js extensions.
Install and use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for a high-end athletic feel.
Install fonts: Barlow Condensed, DM Sans, and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts in index.html.
Do not implement youth sports aesthetics. It must feel like a pro app (e.g., Nike Run Club, GameChanger).
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements, e.g., data-testid='team-registration-button'.
Always use the provided media URLs in the media section. Never use generic placeholders.
For the bottom mobile nav, implement a sticky bar with Home, Schedule, Standings, Profile.
The Demo Role Preview Switcher MUST be a floating persistent element in the bottom right corner.
